protocol.features: 58 fixed causal features,exact13past/current slots,normalized speed/flow,validity,local summaries,within5km positional context,public condition/cutoff/lead. No scene/cell/time identity,noise sigma or latent input.
protocol.sampling: Own latent selected events;history eligible>=.7,ongoing latent>=2 same cell in prior12slots,horizon queue,onset first atT+30,persistenceIoU<=.9. All overlapping origins,not organizer selector.
protocol.history: Past12slots use eligible raw noisy observations;T uses eligible released-like masking. Future eligible mask only training/scoring.
protocol.teachers: Hard threshold of noisy observations;Gaussian ndtr((cut-observed)/known synthetic sigma) flat-prior soft teacher;known latent only synthetic upper reference. No claim soft teacher is true posterior.
protocol.model: All6 LightGBM cross_entropy,300trees/31leaves/lr.035/min_child40/lambda10,feature_fraction.9/bagging.9/freq1/4threads;identical X/rows/weights for each arm and paired optimizer seed.
protocol.weights: Equal condition/equal window,within-window equal legal supervised cells;early onset steps omitted per public timing. No class-dependent weights.
protocol.decision: Fixed equal two-seed probabilities;50 condition thresholds/force settings fitted separately on observed cal and latent cal. Latent-cal settings diagnostic only.
protocol.primary: Observed-cal soft only if gain>=.005 and each condition loss<=.01,else hard. Latent-trained arm not eligible for public pipeline promotion.
protocol.heldout: Assessment/stress generation only after model and decision seals. Same four assessment seeds across stress/noise;not independent new seeds.
protocol.uncertainty: Equal scene available-condition macros then seed means;paired bootstrap4independent seeds,4000resamples. Overlapping windows never independent.
